# scamp_vps_plans (Data Source)

Retrieves the Simple VPS plans.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `backup_share` (Number) Daily backups add this share of the price.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk in GB.
- `id` (String) Plan id, the value for scamp_vps.plan.
- `name` (String) Name of the plan.
- `net_mbit` (Number) Port speed in Mbit/s.
- `price_monthly` (Number) Price a month in EUR.
- `ram_gb` (Number) Memory in GB.
- `traffic_gb` (Number) Outbound traffic included a month, in GB.
- `vcpu` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
